version: v1.2 — 2026-10-21 — 클립 검수(사용자 지시 "클립 돌렸으니 확인해서 영상 만들어봐"): L02 use_from 2.5·loop pingpong · L04 use_to 1.8 · L05 use_from 0.3·use_to 1.3·loop pingpong · L18 use_to 2.1 · L21 use_to 1.7 · L25 use_from 2.4·loop pingpong · L27 use_from 1.8 — 클립 안 겹침·녹아내림 구간을 빼고 씀(tools/assemble_video.py v1.1, 선명도 검사 + 눈으로 확인). 이전 v1.1 — 2026-10-20 — 그림 검수: L02(웃는 얼굴 → 얼굴 없는 신청서 클로즈업)·L19(박 씨 동료 사이에 김 씨·아들·상담 직원 → 주인공은 박 씨만) 다시 그리기 · L05 움직임에서 열쇠를 뺌(그림에 없음) · L22·L23 파일이 바뀌어 올라와 이름을 맞바꿈. 이전 v1.0 — 2026-10-19 — 사용자 지시 "영상은 설명이 복잡하고 어려울 때는 클로드 코드로 렌더링 하고 그렇지 않은 부분은 친숙한 애니메이션 이미지 생성 프롬프트와 그걸 기반으로 짧은 영상 만들어주는 프롬프트 각각 생성해서 영상 만드는걸로 하자" — 대본 v2.1 102문장 중 사연 장면 29개를 AI 클립으로, 나머지(숫자·법·계산·장 시작·정리)는 코드 화면

notice.text: 기사 사례를 바탕으로 각색한 가상 사례

style.image: Warm, friendly 2D animation still, like a frame from a gentle family animated film: clean hand-drawn line art, soft cel shading, warm pastel colors, rounded friendly shapes, cozy natural light, expressive but natural faces. Everyday Korean setting today. Fictional people who do not resemble any real or famous person.
style.motion: Warm friendly 2D animation, soft cel shading, smooth natural motion at normal speed, characters keep the same face, hair and clothes, no text appears.

characters.name: 김 씨 (주인공)
characters.en: Mr. Kim — Korean man, 60 years old but looks youthful like his mid-50s; short neat black hair with gray at the temples; kind round face with thick dark eyebrows; no glasses; navy cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled up over a white T-shirt, beige trousers.

characters.name: 아들 (취업 준비)
characters.en: Mr. Kim's son — Korean man in his late 20s, slim, messy short black hair, light gray hoodie, blue jeans.

characters.name: 동창 친구 (모임에서 물은 사람)
characters.en: Mr. Kim's old school friend — Korean man aged 60, round cheerful face, short gray crew cut, olive-green jacket over a red-and-white checked shirt.

characters.name: 동창 박 씨
characters.en: Mr. Park — another school friend, Korean man aged 60, slim and calm, silver hair neatly combed back, beige jacket over a dark brown turtleneck.

characters.name: 공단 상담 직원
characters.en: Pension office counselor — Korean woman in her 40s, shoulder-length dark hair, white blouse with a navy vest, a blank lanyard card, warm professional smile.

places.name: 김 씨 집
places.en: Mr. Kim's modest Korean apartment: a wooden dining table under a warm pendant lamp, beige walls, a gray fabric sofa in the living room, a wooden cabinet with drawers, framed family photos on a shelf, a window with a city view.

places.name: 동창 모임 식당
places.en: A cozy Korean restaurant: a wooden table with a bubbling stew pot and small side dishes, warm yellow lights, no menu boards or signs.

places.name: 카페
places.en: A quiet, bright café with a window seat, a wooden table and coffee cups.

places.name: 국민연금공단 지사
places.en: A clean, bright public pension office: service counters with clear glass partitions, potted plants, rows of waiting chairs; no signs, no logos, no number displays.

clips.name: L01
clips.ko: 밤 식탁, 통장을 내려다보며 이마를 짚고 고개 떨군 김 씨
clips.image: Night at the dining table. Mr. Kim sits under the warm lamp looking down at an open blank bankbook, one hand pressed to his forehead, head bowed, brows knitted, shoulders slumped — clearly crushed and regretful. A few blank papers on the table. Medium shot, eye level.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim slowly lowers his head further and rubs his forehead, letting out a long sigh as his shoulders sink; the lamp light glows softly; static camera with a very slow push-in.

clips.name: L02
clips.ko: 식탁 위 신청서 한 장 클로즈업, 김 씨의 손
clips.image: Extreme close-up from above of a single application form lying on the dining table under warm lamp light: only empty boxes, gray lines and a signature line, no readable text. A ballpoint pen beside it. Only Mr. Kim's hand and forearm in his navy shirt sleeve rest heavily on the edge of the paper — NO face in the picture (the camera does not show his head). The mood is heavy and regretful: dim warm light, the form looks like the cause of his trouble. Shallow depth of field.
clips.motion: Close-up: Mr. Kim's hand slowly pulls the single form closer across the table and his fingers tap it once; the pen rolls slightly; slow camera push-in, shallow depth of field.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.2~2.4초 손·종이가 겹침(두 손이 반투명 — 선명도 검사로 2.4초까지 남음) → 2.5초부터 끝까지 앞으로·거꾸로

clips.name: L03
clips.ko: 서류·계산기를 펼쳐 놓고 돋보기로 따져 보는 김 씨 (탐정처럼)
clips.image: Mr. Kim at the dining table with papers, a calculator and notes spread out (all blank), holding a magnifying glass and leaning forward, eyes narrowed like a detective about to find a clue. Determined expression. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim leans closer over the papers and slides the magnifying glass slowly across a page, his eyes narrowing, then his eyebrows lift as he notices something; static camera.
clips.ghost_ok: 카메라가 돋보기 쪽으로 다가감 (2026-10-21 그림 확인)

clips.name: L04
clips.ko: 회사 유리문을 나서며 뒤돌아보는 김 씨 (짐 상자)
clips.image: Daytime in front of an office building's glass doors (no signs). Mr. Kim walks out carrying a cardboard box of his belongings — a small potted plant, a mug and a photo frame — and glances back at the building with a bittersweet expression. Full-body shot, the building behind him.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim walks out through the glass door carrying the box, takes a few steps forward and glances back over his shoulder at the building; the plant leaves sway in a light breeze; static camera.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.9초부터 김 씨 앞에 풀줄기가 돋아남 → 앞 1.8초만

clips.name: L05
clips.ko: 퇴직금 통장을 서랍 깊이 넣고 잠그는 김 씨
clips.image: Mr. Kim kneels by the wooden cabinet and places a blank bankbook deep inside an open drawer, a small key in the lock, with a protective, determined look — this money must not be touched. Close-medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim places the bankbook deep into the drawer, pats it once, then slowly slides the drawer shut and nods to himself; static camera.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.45초부터 사람이 겹쳐 보이며 녹아내림 → 0.3~1.3초만 앞으로·거꾸로 (첫 0.25초는 시작 그림에서 넘어오는 프레임이라 색·선명도가 달라 뺌)

clips.name: L06
clips.ko: 공단 창구에서 신청서에 서명해 내미는 김 씨 (다음 달)
clips.image: At a pension office counter, Mr. Kim sits and signs a blank form with a pen, about to slide it under the glass partition; a clerk on the other side is seen from behind, reaching out a hand. Mr. Kim looks calm and a little hurried. Medium shot from the side.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim signs the form and slides it under the glass partition; the clerk takes it and nods; static camera.

clips.name: L07
clips.ko: 거실 소파에서 차를 마시며 여유롭게 웃는 김 씨
clips.image: Daytime in the living room. Mr. Kim leans back comfortably on the gray sofa holding a warm cup of tea, looking out the window with a relaxed, content smile. Soft sunlight through the curtains. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim leans back on the sofa, takes a slow sip of tea and smiles contentedly; steam rises from the cup; the curtains sway gently in the sunlight; static camera.

clips.name: L08
clips.ko: 1년 뒤 동창 모임 — 넷이 웃으며 잔을 부딪침
clips.image: Evening at the cozy Korean restaurant. Four men around 60 sit at the wooden table laughing and clinking glasses at a school reunion. Mr. Kim is in the middle, the friend with the gray crew cut sits across from him. Warm lights, steam from the stew. Medium-wide shot.
clips.motion: The four old friends laugh and clink their glasses together while steam rises from the stew; the camera slowly pushes in toward Mr. Kim and his friend.
clips.ghost_ok: 김 이 오르고 건배 — 겹침 없음 (2026-10-21 그림 확인)

clips.name: L09
clips.ko: 친구가 진지하게 묻고, 잔을 든 채 굳은 김 씨
clips.image: Same restaurant, closer side view of two men. The friend with the gray crew cut leans forward and asks something seriously with his index finger slightly raised; Mr. Kim freezes with his glass halfway to his mouth, eyes wide, smile fading. Medium shot.
clips.motion: The friend leans forward and asks seriously, raising his index finger; Mr. Kim freezes with his glass halfway up, his eyes widening as his smile fades; static camera.

clips.name: L10
clips.ko: 밤, 집에 와 계산기를 꺼내 두드리는 김 씨
clips.image: Night at the dining table. Mr. Kim, just back home, puts a calculator down next to some blank papers and starts pressing its keys with a worried face. The calculator display is blank. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim sets the calculator on the table, sits down and presses its keys quickly with a worried look; static camera.

clips.name: L11
clips.ko: 어깨 너머로 계산기를 보며 고개를 갸웃하는 아들
clips.image: Same table at night. Mr. Kim stares at the calculator, discouraged. Behind him, his son in a gray hoodie peers over his shoulder at the calculator (blank display, just a soft glow) and tilts his head curiously. Medium shot.
clips.motion: The son, standing behind Mr. Kim, peers over his shoulder at the calculator and slowly tilts his head with a puzzled frown; Mr. Kim keeps staring at the calculator; static camera.

clips.name: L12
clips.ko: 옆에 앉아 종이를 가리키며 말하는 아들, 고개 드는 김 씨
clips.image: The son sits down next to Mr. Kim at the table and points at a blank sheet of paper beside the calculator while talking; Mr. Kim looks up at his son in surprise. Warm lamp light. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: The son points at the paper with his finger while talking; Mr. Kim slowly lifts his head and looks at his son, surprised; static camera.

clips.name: L13
clips.ko: 안도의 숨을 쉬다 무언가 떠올라 눈을 크게 뜨는 김 씨
clips.image: Mr. Kim leans back in his dining chair holding a cup of tea, exhaling in relief — and in this moment something suddenly comes back to his mind: his eyes are opening wide. Medium shot, warm light.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim leans back and exhales in relief, then suddenly remembers something — his eyes widen and he sits up straight; slow push-in.

clips.name: L14
clips.ko: 회상 — 경고하듯 말하는 친구, 옆에 작은 만화 폭탄
clips.image: A flashback scene in warm sepia tones with soft blurred edges: at the restaurant table the friend with the gray crew cut raises one hand and talks with a warning look. A small, cute cartoon bomb with a sparkling lit fuse floats beside his head (a simple icon, no text). Medium shot.
clips.motion: In a warm sepia flashback, the friend wags his finger with a warning look while the small cartoon bomb beside him bobs and its fuse sparkles; soft vignette; static camera.

clips.name: L15
clips.ko: 자기 방에서 채용 공고를 넘기며 한숨 쉬는 아들
clips.image: The son's small bedroom. He sits at a desk in front of a laptop scrolling through job listings (the screen shows only blank cards, no text), chin resting on his hand, sighing. A stack of blank résumé papers on the desk. Medium shot.
clips.motion: The son scrolls through the job listings on the laptop, rests his chin on his hand and sighs; the screen glow flickers softly on his face; static camera.

clips.name: L16
clips.ko: 노트북을 함께 들여다보며 찾아보는 김 씨와 아들
clips.image: Mr. Kim and his son lean together toward a laptop on the dining table, searching for information; the son points at the screen (blank charts and cards only) and Mr. Kim looks closely. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim and his son lean toward the laptop; the son scrolls and points at the screen while Mr. Kim nods slowly; static camera.

clips.name: L17
clips.ko: 창가에서 팔짱 끼고 '진짜 범인'을 고민하는 김 씨
clips.image: Mr. Kim stands by the living room window with his arms crossed, head tilted, tapping his chin, deep in thought as if solving a mystery. Daylight, clouds outside. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim stands by the window with arms crossed, tilts his head and taps his chin, deep in thought; clouds drift slowly outside; static camera.

clips.name: L18
clips.ko: 카페에서 통장을 펼쳐 보이는 박 씨, 들여다보는 김 씨
clips.image: At the café window table, Mr. Park (silver combed-back hair, beige jacket) opens his blank bankbook and shows it to Mr. Kim with a calm, confident smile; Mr. Kim leans in to look, surprised. Coffee cups on the table. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Park slides his open bankbook across the table toward Mr. Kim with a calm smile; Mr. Kim leans in to look, surprised; steam rises from the coffee; static camera.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 2.4초에 찻잔이 희미하게 두 겹, 2.8초부터 얼굴도 두 겹 → 앞 2.1초만 (1.35배 늦춤 + 나머지 멈춤)
clips.ghost_ok: 앞 2.1초는 그림으로 깨끗 — 박 씨가 몸을 숙이며 선이 조금 줄어듦 (2026-10-21)

clips.name: L19
clips.ko: 박 씨의 퇴직 날 — 꽃다발을 받고 동료들이 박수
clips.image: Mr. Park's last day at his own office: he holds a bouquet of flowers and smiles while several of his office coworkers around him clap. The coworkers are unnamed background people in plain office clothes who look clearly different from Mr. Kim, his son, the old friend and the pension counselor — none of those four appear in this picture; Mr. Park is the only main character. Bright office, no signs. Medium-wide shot.
clips.motion: Colleagues clap while Mr. Park holds the bouquet and bows slightly with a smile; gentle natural motion; static camera.

clips.name: L20
clips.ko: 신청서를 옆으로 밀어 두고 펜을 내려놓는 박 씨
clips.image: Mr. Park's tidy study at home: he sits at a desk, a blank application form in front of him, and calmly pushes it aside and puts his pen down, leaning back with a relaxed smile. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Park looks at the form, then calmly pushes it aside and puts down his pen, leaning back with a relaxed smile; static camera.

clips.name: L21
clips.ko: 카페 창가에 나란히 앉은 두 사람 — 생각에 잠긴 김 씨, 편안한 박 씨
clips.image: Mr. Kim and Mr. Park sit side by side at the café window counter: Mr. Kim looks down thoughtfully at his cup, Mr. Park sips his coffee calmly. Soft afternoon light. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim looks down thoughtfully while Mr. Park sips his coffee calmly; afternoon light shifts softly; slow camera push-in.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.9~2.4초 찻잔이 입에서 잔받침으로 겹쳐 옮겨 감 → 앞 1.7초만

clips.name: L22
clips.ko: 회상 — 퇴직 전 공책에 계획을 적고 계산기를 두드리는 박 씨
clips.image: A soft-lit flashback: before retiring, Mr. Park sits at his desk writing a plan in a notebook (blank lines only) and using a calculator (blank display), a wall calendar with no numbers behind him. Calm, organized expression. Medium shot.
clips.motion: In a soft-lit flashback, Mr. Park writes in his notebook, taps the calculator, then nods to himself with satisfaction; static camera.

clips.name: L23
clips.ko: 결심한 얼굴로 공단 건물 입구로 걸어가는 김 씨
clips.image: Daytime outside the pension office building: glass entrance doors and potted plants, no signs or logos. Mr. Kim walks toward the entrance holding a document envelope, with a determined face. Full-body shot from slightly behind and to the side.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim walks toward the glass entrance holding the envelope, takes a deep breath and pushes the door open; static camera.

clips.name: L24
clips.ko: 대기석에서 번호표를 쥐고 불안하게 기다리는 김 씨
clips.image: Inside the pension office waiting area: Mr. Kim sits on a waiting chair clutching a small blank ticket, his knee bouncing, glancing anxiously toward the counters. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim sits clutching the ticket, his knee bouncing nervously as he glances toward the counters and swallows; static camera.

clips.name: L25
clips.ko: 친절히 설명하는 상담 직원, 몸을 내밀며 놀라는 김 씨
clips.image: At the service counter, the counselor (shoulder-length dark hair, navy vest) points at a blank document and explains kindly; across from her Mr. Kim leans forward, eyes wide with surprise and hope. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: The counselor points at the document and explains kindly; Mr. Kim leans forward, his eyes widening with surprise and hope; static camera.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.7~2.1초 상담 직원 얼굴이 두 겹 → 2.4초부터 끝까지 앞으로·거꾸로

clips.name: L26
clips.ko: 밤 식탁, 공책을 펴고 손가락 두 개를 펴며 따져 보는 김 씨
clips.image: Night at the dining table: Mr. Kim sits with an open notebook (blank lines) and a pen, holding up two fingers as he weighs two things, thoughtful and focused. Warm lamp light. Medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim raises two fingers while thinking, then lowers his hand and starts writing in the notebook; static camera.

clips.name: L27
clips.ko: 장식장의 가족사진 — 아흔 넘은 어른들 사진을 보며 미소 짓는 김 씨
clips.image: Living room shelf with framed family photos of very old, smiling relatives in their nineties (a grandmother and grandfather). Mr. Kim holds one frame and looks at it fondly with a gentle smile. Medium close shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim lifts the framed photo of his elderly relatives and looks at it fondly as a gentle smile spreads; slow push-in; static camera otherwise.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.0~1.7초 카메라가 다가가며 김 씨가 두 겹 → 1.8초부터

clips.name: L28
clips.ko: 서랍에서 아껴 둔 퇴직금 통장을 꺼내 보며 고개를 끄덕이는 김 씨
clips.image: Mr. Kim kneels by the same wooden cabinet, the drawer open, and holds up the blank bankbook he saved, looking at it with a calm, confident nod. Close-medium shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim takes the bankbook out of the drawer, opens it and nods slowly with confidence; static camera.

clips.name: L29
clips.ko: 다음 날 창구에 서류를 내는 김 씨, 웃으며 받는 상담 직원
clips.image: The next day at the pension office counter: Mr. Kim hands a blank form across the counter, the counselor receives it with a smile, and Mr. Kim smiles with relief. Bright morning light. Medium two-shot.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim hands the form across the counter; the counselor takes it with a smile and nods; Mr. Kim smiles with relief; static camera.
